gloss: in pieces; into fragments; smashed to bits

definitions.gloss: in pieces; into fragments; smashed to bits
definitions.explanation: Describes something being broken or shattered into many small pieces. Used both literally for physical objects and figuratively for things like dreams or hopes.

examples.japanese: コップが{粉々|こなごな}に{割|わ}れた。
{落|お}とした{皿|さら}が{粉々|こなごな}になってしまった。
examples.english: The plate I dropped was smashed to bits.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{夢|ゆめ}が{粉々|こなごな}に{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}かれた{気持|きも}ちだった。
examples.english: I felt as though my long-held dream had been shattered to pieces.

notes: Almost always appears with the particle に: {粉々|こなごな}に{割|わ}れる (to shatter into pieces), {粉々|こなごな}に{砕|くだ}く (to crush to bits), {粉々|こなごな}になる (to be smashed to pieces). Can also function as a na-adjective: {粉々|こなごな}な{状態|じょうたい} (a shattered state). The word is a reduplication of {粉|こな} (powder), emphasizing complete fragmentation. Related: ばらばら (scattered in pieces — suggests separation rather than shattering), めちゃくちゃ (wrecked, in a mess — broader destruction).
